verdict.rationale: Vapi is an API platform, so API versioning and a deprecation policy are a fair question to ask of it. However, none of the evidence mentions API version identifiers, version pinning, changelogs, or a deprecation policy; the CLI, MCP server, webhooks and SDK snippets are unrelated to versioning.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
